thread:
Diego: heads-up — Fathom (enterprise) just escalated a major degradation in their doc search rerank after last week’s infra deploy. ticket: https://support.redwood.example/t/98765 :exclamation:
Ava: thanks. how bad is it? impact on relevance / latency?
Diego: reported relevancy drop on rerank top-5. They say 'results are less coherent, more noise; exact match recall down'. Measured hit rate on their eval set: 92% -> 68% since deploy on 2026-02-10. latency unchanged.
Sam: Fathom says CTR on search snippet fell ~18% week-over-week, some revenue flows tied to search. They're asking for prioritization — want ETA and mitigation.
Omar: adding minimal repro data to the ticket now — payload size, model used, sample queries. embedding model: embed-large-v2, dims=1536, batch size usually 32 for production. Attaching logs.
deploy-bot: Deploy 2026-02-10 03:12 UTC — rollout candidate "ranker-2026-02" to production (canary 10% -> 100%).
Rina: can we get a small labeled set (50-200 queries) showing before/after scoring? need top-k lists + relevance labels. I suspect a calibration/score-shift in reranker scoring or a quantization/float->int step in the new rollout.
Diego: uploaded sample dataset: /attachments/fathom_sample_2026-02-12.json (50 queries, gold relevance). also some failing example queries inline in ticket.
Ava: OK — propose two paths and decide scope:
• Fast mitigation (1–3 days): tune reranker score threshold / revert the ranking weight change; feature-flag a fallback to previous weights; monitor NDGC@10 on their dataset.
• Proper fix (4–8 weeks): full offline eval, model/feature ablation, potential small finetune or quantization rollback, then staged rollout + canary + rollout policy in console.
Rina: that matches my assessment. Fast mitigation likely involves flipping the 'ranker-weight-v2' flag. I can test locally and validate on the sample set. Proper fix needs dataset expansion and regression tests.
Ava: For product backlog/prioritization we need acceptance criteria for the fast mitigation and the proper fix. Suggest:
• Fast mitigation acceptance criteria: NDGC@10 on Fathom sample increases to within 5% of pre-deploy baseline (i.e., >=87%), no tail latency increases >5%, and customer confirms improved experience in 48 hours.
• Proper fix acceptance criteria: NDCG@10 restored >= pre-deploy baseline across expanded holdout (n=1000 queries), documented ablation notes, rollout plan with canary + auto-fallback, unit/regression tests in CI, and a postmortem with RCA.
Sam: Fathom will accept a temporary fix if we can commit to a timeline for the proper fix and weekly updates.
Diego: customer priority = P1 for next sprint if quick mitigation is >50% likely; otherwise P0 and triage into Q2 roadmap for proper fix.
Omar: reproducer command for Rina:
```
python tools/eval_rerank.py \
  --queries attachments/fathom_sample_2026-02-12.json \
  --emb-model embed-large-v2 \
  --reranker-config config/ranker-v2.json \
  --metric ndcg@10
```
Rina: running now on local GPU, will post baseline numbers. also checking for any kernel/quantization warnings in logs.
Ava: product asks engineering to estimate: 1) time to test & flip flag + verification (days), 2) time for thorough evaluation + fix (weeks). please add estimates as comments and we'll add a scoped ticket with launch criteria.
Rina: estimate for fast mitigation: 1-2 dev days (test + staging + canary); verification and monitoring 1 day. proper fix: 4–6 weeks (data prep, ablations, QA, rollout).
Diego: I'm drafting a backlog ticket now and will include the acceptance criteria above, link to customer ticket, and the sample set. tagging @Ava for prioritization.
Ava: please include rollback plan (flag revert, traffic steering to previous model variant), SLO checks (ndcg monitor + alerting), and a customer communication plan. I'll slot this for review in tomorrow's roadmap sync and weigh against other P1s.
Sam: I'll message Fathom to set expectations: temporary fix window and tentative timeline for comprehensive fix. they'll want weekly checkpoints.
Rina: quick update — local run shows NDCG@10 pre-deploy: 0.912, post-deploy: 0.684 on sample. flipping weight flag restores to 0.901. pushing a canary test in staging now.
Diego: :thumbsup: please keep me in the loop. once staging canary looks good we can fast-track to prod with a narrow percentage rollout and watch metrics.
Ava: perfect. action items: Diego create backlog ticket + attach sample; Rina test + prepare PR to flip flag; Omar coordinate staging canary; Sam customer comms; product review in roadmap sync. changing priority to P0->P1 provisional. 
Rina: will post PR link and staging metrics timestamped.
deploy-bot: Canary deployment scheduled: ranker-weight-fallback -> 2026-02-13 14:00 UTC (10% traffic)
Sam: noting customer asked for weekly status until full resolution. I'll keep the thread updated.
Diego: thanks all — keeping this pinned.
